business_summary: Bluebird Bakes is tightening retailer launch controls after a label mistake. Current source-policy evidence says CrumbCRM owns sales stages and next sales actions, while KitchenBoard owns launch tasks and milestones until LaunchPad takes over that status role on 2026-07-20. GreenMart is an active frozen pastry pilot with allergen label, case pack, shipment booking, customer approval, and contract-review dependencies. Lakeside Coffee is an earlier seasonal croissant opportunity waiting on final pricing before a proposal.
